name: Elemental Weapon

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

targets.description: a nonmagical weapon; the bonuses go to whoever wields it

upcast.text: With a level 5-6 slot the bonus is +2 and the extra damage 2d4; with a level 7+ slot, +3 and 3d4.

modifiers.text: +2 with a level 5-6 slot, +3 with a level 7+ slot.

summary: A nonmagical weapon becomes +1 and deals an extra 1d4 of a chosen element (more with higher slots).
text: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder: until the spell ends, the weapon has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type when it hits. Concentration, up to 1 hour. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: with a level 5-6 slot the bonus is +2 and the extra damage 2d4; with a level 7+ slot the bonus is +3 and the extra damage 3d4.
